headline: Chilean Developer Ingevec Reports 27% Profit Rise and Prepares 14 Projects
summary: Chile's Ingevec reported a 27% increase in net profit and a 38% rise in revenue through September. The construction firm announced plans to launch 14 new housing developments valued at 11.5 million UF.
why: Ingevec S.A. is a major engineering and residential property developer operating in Chile.
